title: Bitcoin Holds Its Pivot On A Quiet Columbus Day: Key Crypto Levels
speaker: Jake Sweeney

macro_themes.view: Columbus Day brought light stock volume and little crypto volatility; levels-focused, no macro thesis.

calls.condition: If BTC holds above the 82,814 pivot it can push to the ascending trend line (~87,38x) then 87,395; losing it opens the descending support trend line at 77-78k where bears would be in control
calls.reason: Broke below 82,814 last Wednesday and has traded on it since; 87,395 is a heavily traded shelf that flipped to resistance.
calls.quote: bears would be in control if we came down to this 77-78,000 level for this trend line. But let's try and keep Bitcoin above this …

calls.condition: If ETH cracks 2,667 it can test the descending trend line from Dec 11 2025 around 2,700-2,758 later this week; breakout possible after 5-6 touches
calls.reason: Bounced off a support trend line from the Feb 5 2026 low; 2,667 wick high is the first resistance, then the multi-touch descending trend line.
calls.quote: five to six hits on this trend line. uh could break to the upside soon

calls.reason: Broke below ascending trend line (now resistance ~1.4578) and is hugging the old breakout trend line; expects a move down to the 1.2702 September low.
calls.quote: I want price to keep coming down here to this 12702 low here

calls.condition: Resistance expected at ~114.94 trend line; if 105-106 support gives, could drop to 101-102
calls.reason: Rejected at a broken-down trend line; ascending trend line (old resistance flipped to support) at 105-106.
calls.quote: Should we push up to about 11494? I do expect some resistance here from this trend line

calls.reason: Down-sloping parallel channel after 52-week high at 98.01; he views down-sloping channels as usually breaking upward.
calls.quote: when you have these downs sloping parallel channels, uh to me these are usually bullish um and break to the upside

calls.condition: A daily close above ~129.77/135 opens a retest of the broken wedge at ~161-163; otherwise support trend line ~113.4-113.7
calls.reason: Rejected at a trend line from Nov 6 2025 after a retest; support trend line from Apr 9 2026.
calls.quote: so we have to get past that level

notes: Recorded Monday Oct 12 (Columbus Day) afternoon. Numbers spoken without decimals; interpreted XRP '14578/12702/135' as 1.4578/1.2702/1.35, SOL as 114.94/107.01, HYPE as 98.01/82.51, ZEC '1358/129777/1611 1628/11:37' as ~135/129.77/161.1-162.8/113.4-113.7 (ZEC decimals uncertain). BTC first trend-line level garbled ('87,38'). No BTC/ETH current price stated; BTC was trading around its 82,814 pivot.
